answer_1.quote: The aim of the clinical note summarization task T is to train the model π ref (y i |x i ).

answer_2.quote: We experiment with GPT-2 and Llama2 and evaluate the quality of the trained models for summarization using ROUGEL and for factuality using G-Eval and UMLS-F1.

answer_3.quote: G-Eval evaluates factual alignment using the GPT-4 chain-of-thought to assess the factuality when prompted to generate a factuality score (Appendix D)

answer_4.quote: We relied on 1 doctor and 2 medical students as annotators for human evaluation and preference results.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to annotate each instruction with its hallucination/factuality label along with a justification comment, and to give a preference label between summary pairs.
